arguments.command:
cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.deps timeout 100 python3 -u -c "
import sys, json, time, cProfile, pstats, io
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen, verify
from protocol import loads as raw_loads, validate as raw_validate
import main as entry
text = json.dumps(gen.valid_request(1000, style=1), separators=(',',':'))
print('req bytes', len(text), flush=True)
t0=time.time()
pr = cProfile.Profile(); pr.enable()
resp = entry.solve(raw_validate(raw_loads(text)))
pr.disable()
print('solve', round(time.time()-t0,3), flush=True)
s = io.StringIO(); pstats.Stats(pr, stream=s).sort_stats('cumulative').print_stats(12); print(s.getvalue())
" 2>&1 | head -40
